entries.name: BI 3034701
entries.developer: Boehringer Ingelheim; developed in cooperation with Gubra
entries.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim, working with Gubra, is developing an injectable GLP-1/GIP/NPY2 receptor agonist for obesity or overweight. Its Phase 2 study records 344 actual participants and began on 30 June 2026. Completion is estimated in 2027; no results are posted. A separate Phase 1 dose-titration study remains recruiting.
entries.ukAuthorisation: Not established by the reviewed research sources. UK trial locations do not establish a marketing authorisation.
entries.limitations: Sponsor descriptions of differentiation and earlier tolerability are not evidence of comparative effectiveness, proven muscle preservation or established safety and efficacy.
entries.nhsEngland: Not established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: No commercial UK supply or pharmacy stock established.
